what_happened: The job moved the Transport row from gh/mod.rs to gh/transport.rs. It was rejected at the final verdict. 1 of 6 acceptance criteria was unmet: the report must list the caller-check Grep for each moved name's old path. There was one major finding: the producer's report was not given to the verifier, so the criterion could not be confirmed. No failed checks are listed. The other 5 criteria were met, so the code move itself may be sound. The rejection says nothing about the move being wrong. It says the evidence was missing.
cause: Nothing in code checks that the producer's report reaches the verifier, or that a criterion about report content can be judged from what the verifier receives. A criterion that depends on the report is judged only at the final verdict. If the report is missing from the verifier's input, the verdict is "cannot confirm", and rejection is the only outcome. The handover from producer to verifier is not checked before verification starts. The reading also makes a report-content criterion an acceptance gate, without a step that shows the verifier has the report. This is an inference, since the stored fields do not show what the producer wrote or what the verifier was given.
prevention: Before the verifier is dispatched, a code check confirms that the producer's report exists, is non-empty, and is included in the verifier's input. If any acceptance criterion refers to the report's content, the job is held at handover when the report is absent, and is not sent to the verifier to be rejected. The same check can also confirm that the report has the sections the criteria name, such as a caller-check section listing one Grep per moved name. A missing report then becomes a handover error that is fixed before the final verdict.
proposed_request: Make Athena check the producer-to-verifier handover before verification starts. Outcome: when a job's acceptance criteria refer to the producer's report (for example, that it lists a caller-check Grep for each moved name's old path), the verifier always receives that report. If the report is missing or empty, the job stops at handover with a clear message that the report is absent. It is not sent to the verifier and rejected as "cannot confirm". Show this with a test in which a job's report is withheld: the job is held at handover and not rejected, and with the report present the verifier input includes it. Then retry job 20261027-004517-gk9e (move the Transport row from gh/mod.rs to gh/transport.rs), so that its report, including the caller-check Grep for each moved name's old path, reaches the verifier.
